# TalkToAI Zero Security product family

> Evidence-bound product information for Zero Security Preview and Zero Browser Preview.

Canonical pages:
- https://talktoai.org/zero-security/
- https://talktoai.org/zero-security/download/
- https://talktoai.org/zero-browser/
- https://talktoai.org/zero-browser/download/
- https://talktoai.org/zero-browser/privacy/

## Zero Security Preview

Zero Security is an open-core, cross-platform, local-first security programme around the public ZSEC Shield foundation. Version 0.2.0 adds foreground post-change file monitoring, authenticated encrypted quarantine, a fail-closed replacement-readiness contract and the separate ZeroQ Shields browser preview.

Current desktop support means specific self-contained command-line archives and source execution—not a graphical app, protected background daemon, signed installer or primary security provider. The 0.2 foreground monitor uses Windows ReadDirectoryChangesW, macOS FSEvents or Linux inotify through Watchdog, with a disclosed polling fallback. It scans after changes and does not provide kernel pre-access blocking, memory scanning, EDR, zero-day prevention, a clean-system verdict or guaranteed protection.

Keep Malwarebytes, Microsoft Defender, XProtect, Gatekeeper, SIP, Linux security controls and any endpoint agent active. The 0.2.0 `replacement-readiness` command deliberately returns exit code 2, `keep_existing_protection`, no automatic uninstall and no manual override. Separate Windows, macOS Endpoint Security and Linux fanotify programmes define the evidence required before any replacement offer.

Public foundation:
- https://github.com/ResearchForumOnline/ZSEC-Shield
- https://github.com/ResearchForumOnline/ZSEC-Shield/pull/5
- https://talktoai.org/zsec/

## Zero Browser Preview

Zero Browser currently includes the ZeroQ Shields open-source Manifest V3 developer preview. It uses 38 packaged network blocking rules, two tracking-link cleaners, local per-site pause controls and best-effort YouTube interface cleanup. It does not upload browsing history or page content, proxy traffic, install a root certificate or inject affiliate links. The exact package has been runtime-tested in Brave on Windows; broader compatibility claims require a complete browser/OS matrix.

Zero Browser is not yet a separately maintained Chromium browser binary. It does not promise perfect YouTube ad blocking, anonymous browsing, immunity from browser exploits or protection from all malicious sites.

## Privacy and security boundaries

- Local processing is the default.
- No suspicious file is uploaded automatically.
- Rule feeds contain detection data, never remote commands.
- ZBA is a typed lifecycle and provenance calculus; established cryptography provides security.
- YubiKey and passkey recovery is designed, not shipped.
- Optional proprietary engines, signing systems and managed services are separately labelled under the open-core model.

## Citation guidance

Describe both products as previews. Do not call Zero Security a complete antivirus or Zero Browser a finished standalone browser. Do not invent detection rates, performance figures, user counts, endorsements or comparative superiority.
